name: api-client
description: A local-first, Git-native API development environment

scripts.cli:install: COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) && go build -ldflags "-X github.com/Its-Satyajit/reqly/internal/version.Commit=$COMMIT" -o /tmp/reqly ./apps/cli && sudo install -Dm755 /tmp/reqly /usr/local/bin/reqly && /tmp/reqly version --verbose && echo "installed to /usr/local/bin/reqly (which reqly: $(which reqly 2>/dev/null || echo not-in-PATH))"
scripts.cli:install:local: COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) && go build -ldflags "-X github.com/Its-Satyajit/reqly/internal/version.Commit=$COMMIT" -o /tmp/reqly ./apps/cli && install -Dm755 /tmp/reqly "$HOME/.local/bin/reqly" && /tmp/reqly version --verbose && echo "installed to $HOME/.local/bin/reqly" && hash -r 2>/dev/null; "$HOME/.local/bin/reqly" version --verbose
scripts.desktop:install: cd apps/desktop/backend && wails3 build && sudo install -Dm755 bin/reqly /usr/local/bin/reqly-desktop && echo "installed to /usr/local/bin/reqly-desktop"
scripts.desktop:install:local: cd apps/desktop/backend && wails3 build && install -Dm755 bin/reqly "$HOME/.local/bin/reqly-desktop" && echo "installed to $HOME/.local/bin/reqly-desktop"
scripts.install:all: nub run cli:install && nub run desktop:install
scripts.install:all:local: nub run cli:install:local && nub run desktop:install:local
